## 2. Professional Philosophy & Value Proposition

Traditional digital growth models force founders to hire three disconnected entities:
1. A front-end web developer or Shopify freelancer who does not understand advertising pixels or data schemas.
2. A performance marketing agency or ad buyer who blames the website when ads fail to convert.
3. An automation contractor or Zapier freelancer who creates expensive, brittle third-party integrations.

When conversion rates drop or campaigns misfire, each party blames the others. Ravi Chawra eliminates this friction by operating as an integrated **Solo Systems Builder**:
- One engineer designs and codes the website for sub-2-second mobile load speeds.
- The same engineer instruments server-side tracking (Meta Conversion API / CAPI) with deduplicated client signals.
- The same engineer writes and deploys the ad campaigns aligned with actual product landing pages.
- The same engineer constructs resilient backend workflows (primarily self-hosted n8n) so leads route directly to WhatsApp or CRM without monthly SaaS tax.

**Key Operating Principles:**
- **Zero Middlemen:** Direct communication over WhatsApp or scheduled calls. No account managers or ticket queues.
- **Fixed Upfront Pricing:** Transparent quotes per sprint or build. No unexpected hourly billing or endless retainers.
- **Ownership:** Clients retain 100% ownership of source code, domains, ad accounts, and automation credentials.
- **Speed to Execution:** Initial project audits and build execution start within 48 to 72 hours.

## 3. Technology Stack & Technical Competencies

### Frontend & Web Engineering
- **Core Frameworks:** Next.js (App Router, Turbopack, Server Components, SSR/SSG/ISR), React 19, TypeScript
- **Styling & UI:** Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Vanilla CSS, Responsive Brutalist & Minimalist Design Systems
- **Headless CMS & Content:** Sanity.io CMS, GROQ Query Language, Portable Text
- **Performance & Web Vitals:** Core Web Vitals (LCP < 1.8s, CLS = 0.00, INP < 100ms), AVIF/WebP image pipelines, Brotli/Gzip compression, tree-shaking, lazy-loading

### E-Commerce & D2C
- **Platforms:** Shopify, Shopify Hydrogen, Liquid theme architecture
- **Cart & Checkout Optimization:** High-converting single-page checkout flows, cart abandonment triggers, speed audits, app bloat elimination

### Workflow Automation & AI Integrations
- **Automation Engines:** n8n (self-hosted and cloud), Webhooks, REST APIs
- **Integrations:** WhatsApp Cloud API, Telegram, Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion, Slack, Stripe, Razorpay
- **AI Pipelines:** OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude API, DeepSeek, custom LLM tool-calling agents and automated response agents

### Performance Marketing & Measurement
- **Ad Platforms:** Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram Ads Manager), Google Ads
- **Server-Side Tracking:** Meta Conversion API (CAPI) via Cloudflare Workers, Stape, or custom n8n webhooks
- **Analytics & Observability:** Google Tag Manager (GTM Server-Side), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Vercel Analytics, Speed Insights

## 4. Verified Client Case Studies

### Case Study 1: Vyonnastore.in (D2C Jewelry Brand)
- **URL:** https://vyonnastore.in
- **Scope:** Complete Shopify storefront build, automated abandoned checkout recovery sequences, and performance Meta Ads configuration.
- **Problem:** Low mobile conversion rate, high checkout drop-offs, and lack of follow-up on abandoned shopping carts.
- **Solution:** 
  - Designed and deployed a fast, modern Shopify store highlighting jewelry collections with optimized product page layouts.
  - Engineered an automated n8n workflow connecting Shopify checkout webhooks to personalized WhatsApp and email recovery messages.
  - Implemented Meta Ads with accurate server-side pixel tracking (CAPI) to optimize purchase events.
- **Client Quote:**
  > "Ravi was incredibly responsive throughout — quick replies, quick fixes, no chasing needed. Working with him felt easy from start to finish."  
  > — *Prateek Chhugani, Founder, Vyonnastore*

### Case Study 2: M.R.K. Public School (Institutional Web Portal)
- **URL:** https://mrkpublicschool.netlify.app/
- **Scope:** Web design, frontend engineering, mobile accessibility, and admission inquiry pipeline.
- **Problem:** Outdated portal with slow load times on mobile 4G/3G connections and cumbersome paper-based admission queries.
- **Solution:**
  - Built a lightweight, accessible web portal with zero heavy script dependencies, loading in under 1.5 seconds on mobile.
  - Integrated direct parent lead capture routing admission forms immediately to administrative staff.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q1: Can I hire Ravi Chawra for just one specific task (e.g. only web dev or only n8n automation)?
**Answer:** Yes. While Ravi's primary strength is end-to-end integration across web, ads, and automations, he frequently takes on focused sprints — such as a standalone Shopify build, an n8n lead routing pipeline, or a Meta CAPI tracking fix.

### Q2: How long does a typical build take?
**Answer:** A dedicated landing page or targeted automation workflow typically takes 4 to 7 days. A full store build or multi-system setup takes 10 to 14 days. Continuous progress previews are provided throughout the process.

### Q3: What happens if something breaks after launch?
**Answer:** Every project includes post-launch support and warranty. Ravi verifies all pixel tracking events, checkout flows, and automated triggers in live production environments and handles adjustments immediately.

### Q4: How does pricing work?
**Answer:** Pricing is upfront and fixed-scope per project. After an initial 30-minute discovery call, you receive a detailed proposal covering scope, timeline, deliverables, and exact cost. There are no surprise hourly rates or hidden retainers.
